title: Guadalajara International Book Fair 2026
summary: Our first appearance, on the Türkiye collective stand.
body:
Epsilon Publishing Group will make its first appearance at the Guadalajara International Book Fair, taking place from 28 November to 6 December 2026, as part of the Türkiye collective stand.

As Latin America’s leading publishing gathering and the largest meeting of the Spanish-language publishing world, Guadalajara offers an exciting opportunity to explore the region’s markets and connect with publishers face to face. We look forward to introducing our children’s and adult lists, discovering new opportunities for rights partnerships and building relationships that will help our authors’ stories reach new readers.

Come and meet us at the Türkiye collective stand!
